info.title: General Ledger
info.description: The General Ledger is where a company creates and maintains accounts, journals, and financial reports. You use the General Ledger to post journal entries, design and run reports, create budgets, and more. Other Sage Intacct subscriptions automatically post transactions to the General Ledger in real-time.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Accounts
tags.description:
A General Ledger account records balance sheet, income statement, or statistical transactions and organizes them by account type within a company's Chart of Accounts.

**When to use:** Use when creating, retrieving, updating, or deleting accounts and when configuring account behavior for transaction posting, tax reporting, reconciliation, or dimensional requirements.

**Relationships:** An account can be associated with another account for closing activity and can be configured for subledger control, tax reporting, and General Ledger matching.

**Lifecycle context:** Accounts are maintained as part of the company's ongoing financial reporting and transaction-posting processes.

For more information, see [Accounts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_accounts) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account categories
tags.description:
Account categories are high-level classifications for accounts that appear in balance sheets and income statements. Each category has an account type and normal balance and can be used for tracking statistical data. For companies using the QuickStart template, Sage Intacct provides ready-made account groups based on account categories to simplify setup.

**When to use:** Use account categories to retrieve category details and, for companies using a QuickStart template, classify General Ledger accounts while configuring or reviewing a chart of accounts.

**Relationships:** For companies using a QuickStart template, General Ledger accounts can be assigned to account categories, and Sage Intacct uses those categories to provide ready-made account groups.

**Lifecycle context:** Account categories are predefined, read-only classifications. They can be retrieved throughout the lifecycle of the chart of accounts but cannot be created or updated through this API.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account ranges
tags.description:
An account range defines the lower and upper account numbers that determine which GL accounts it includes. Account groups can include account ranges as group members, along with individual named accounts.

**When to use:** Use account ranges to group GL accounts within an account group for reporting and analysis.

**Relationships:** Owned by an account group and defined by starting and ending GL accounts.

**Lifecycle context:** Account ranges are typically created and maintained as part of the configuration of the General Ledger. Changes to account ranges may impact reporting and analysis within the accounting system.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account name entity maps
tags.description:
An account name entity map assigns a location-specific title to a General Ledger account in a multi-entity company.

**When to use:** Use account name entity maps when the same General Ledger account needs different titles for different locations, such as for location-specific financial reporting.

**Relationships:** Each map links a General Ledger account to a location.

**Lifecycle context:** The map is created or updated during multi-entity financial setup to maintain a location-specific title for a General Ledger account.

For more information, see [account titles by entity](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Account_titles_by_entity) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account allocations
tags.description:
An account allocation defines how amounts from a source pool are distributed across dimensions such as departments, locations, projects, or classes. Its definition includes the rationale, source pool, basis, and target entry details.

**When to use:** Use an account allocation to configure how source amounts are distributed, then create an allocation run to generate entries for selected dates.

**Relationships:** Each account allocation includes a source pool, basis, target, and reverse definition. Together, these specify the amounts to allocate, how to distribute them, where to create the entries, and whether allocated amounts remain in the allocation book or are moved to another book using copy and reverse.

**Lifecycle context:** Create and configure the allocation definition before generating allocations. Use an allocation run to generate entries for the desired dates.

For more information, read about [Account (dynamic) allocations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_allocations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account allocation groups
tags.description:
An account allocation group organizes account allocations for coordinated processing. Members can be ordered so that prerequisite allocations are processed first.

**When to use:** Use account allocation groups to process several allocations together and control their processing order when allocations depend on one another.

**Relationships:** Each group contains ordered members that reference account allocations.

**Lifecycle context:** Configure whether processing stops after a member fails or skips the failed member and continues.

For more information, see [Account allocation groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=aa_toc_allocation_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account allocation group members
tags.description:
An account allocation group member links an account allocation to the group that processes it.

**When to use:** Use account allocation group members to retrieve the allocations included in a group.

**Relationships:** Each member belongs to an account allocation group and references the account allocation processed as part of that group. Members can be created and updated only through their owning account allocation group.

For more information, see [Account allocation groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=aa_toc_allocation_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account allocation runs
tags.description:
An account allocation run records the execution of an account allocation or account allocation group, including its processing status and any associated journal entry.

**When to use:** Use to execute an account allocation or group, or to check its processing status and associated journal entry.

**Relationships:** A run refers to the allocation or allocation group it executes. It may also reference a parent run, a recurring allocation, and a journal entry generated during processing.

**Lifecycle context:** Runs track execution through queued and in-progress states and record a successful, failed, or partial-success outcome when processing finishes.

For more information, see [Generating allocations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Generate_account_allocations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account allocation sources
tags.description:
An account allocation source defines the account group and criteria Intacct uses to identify source amounts for an account allocation. Dimension groups or dimension values can narrow the source pool.

**When to use:** Use an account allocation source to specify the reporting period, account group, percentage to allocate, and reporting-book settings for calculating source amounts.

**Relationships:** An account allocation source belongs to an account allocation and references the account group and reporting period used to select source amounts. It can also include adjustment books and dimension filters.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured as part of an account allocation, the source is used when the allocation runs to determine the amounts available for allocation.

For more information, read about [Account (dynamic) allocations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_allocations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account allocation basis
tags.description:
An account allocation basis defines the account activity or balances used to calculate splits for a dynamic account allocation.

**When to use:** Use when configuring a dynamic account allocation to select the account group, reporting period, and accounting rules used to calculate allocation splits.

**Relationships:** Owned by an account allocation, with associated basis adjustment books. It references an account group, reporting period, and the dimension groups or dimension values used to determine basis amounts.

**Lifecycle context:** Created through its owning account allocation rather than directly — this endpoint supports retrieving and updating an existing basis. The basis is evaluated when the allocation runs, to determine how the source pool is distributed.

For more information, see [Create an account allocation definition](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Account_allocations_definitions) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account allocation targets
tags.description:
An account allocation target specifies where amounts from the source pool are distributed when a dynamic account allocation is generated.

**When to use:** Use when configuring an account allocation to choose the GL account, journal, and dimension overrides for generated amounts. For allocations that cross entities, set the exchange rate type here.

**Relationships:** Owned by an account allocation and associated with an account group. It can also reference a GL account, journal, and dimensions used as target overrides.

**Lifecycle context:** Created through its owning account allocation rather than directly — this endpoint supports retrieving and updating an existing target. These settings determine the account, journal, and dimensions used on the entries generated each time the allocation runs.

For more information, see [Account (dynamic) allocations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_allocations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account allocation reversals
tags.description:
An account allocation reversal defines the account and dimension values used on the offsetting entries for a dynamic account allocation.

**When to use:** Use to set the account and dimension values applied to the reversing source pool entries. You can reuse the accounts from the source pool account group, or nominate a separate reversal account.

**Relationships:** Owned by an account allocation. References the GL account used for the reversal and any dimension overrides applied to the reversing entries.

**Lifecycle context:** Created through its owning account allocation rather than directly — this endpoint supports retrieving and updating an existing reversal. These settings are applied to the reversing source pool entries each time the allocation generates.

For more information, see [Account (dynamic) allocations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_allocations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Recurring account allocations
tags.description:
A recurring account allocation schedules an account allocation, or an account allocation group, to run automatically at defined intervals.

**When to use:** Use to set up and maintain automated allocation schedules, and to monitor scheduled runs — the next and last run dates, the most recent execution status, and how many times the schedule has run.

**Relationships:** References either an account allocation or an account allocation group, along with the entity it belongs to. Links to the scheduled operation and the processing operation that carry out each run. Timing settings are held in an embedded schedule.

**Lifecycle context:** Once saved, the schedule repeats at the configured interval, generating allocation journal entries on each run. When `allocateToPeriodEnd` is `true`, the first scheduled run occurs at the start of the next period, with journal entries dated at the preceding period end. It continues until it reaches its end date, completes its set number of occurrences, or is stopped.

For more information, see [Schedule recurring allocations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Account_allocations_recurring) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account groups
tags.description:
An account group organizes General Ledger accounts into reusable structures that define the accounting data and totals shown in financial reports.

**When to use:** Use account groups to select accounting data for financial reports, graphs, and dashboard performance cards. Create hierarchical structures such as Net Income or flat groups such as Cash and Cash Equivalents.

**Relationships:** Account groups can contain account ranges, accounts, other account groups, category members, or computation members. They can also be associated with an account group purpose and dimension filters.

**Lifecycle context:** Account groups are created, updated, and deleted as part of the financial reporting setup and maintenance process.

For more information, see [Account groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_account_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account group purposes
tags.description:
An account group purpose classifies account groups according to their intended use, which helps organize financial reporting.

**When to use:** Use when creating, retrieving, updating, or deleting classifications that identify why account groups are used in financial reporting.

**Relationships:** Assigned to account groups when the groups are created or updated.

**Lifecycle context:** Created before they are assigned to account groups and retained as reference data for reporting.

For more information, see [About the account group purpose](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_acct_group_purpose) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account group members
tags.description:
An account group member represents an account group owned by another account group. The owned account group can contain member accounts or other account groups. Account groups can organize individual GL accounts or statistical accounts at the first level, and can contain other account groups to build a hierarchy.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving or analyzing the account groups that make up a hierarchical account group, including their order within the owning group.

**Relationships:** Owned by an account group and references the included account group. The included account group can contain member accounts or other account groups.

**Lifecycle context:** Created as part of an owning account group and remains available until the relationship is removed or the owning account group is deleted.

For more information, see [Introduction to account groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Introducing_account_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account group category members
tags.description:
An account group category member associates a reporting category with an account group.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve the reporting categories assigned to an account group.

**Relationships:** Owned by an account group and linked to a reporting category.

**Lifecycle context:** Created as part of an account group and remains available until the relationship is removed or the account group is deleted.

For more information, see [Introduction to account groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Introducing_account_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Computation account groups
tags.description:
A computation account group defines a mathematical formula using other account groups, individual General Ledger accounts, or constants. The calculated result appears in financial reports.

**When to use:** Use computation account groups to calculate values for financial reports from account groups, account balances, or constants.

**Relationships:** Owned by a General Ledger account group and can reference other account groups and General Ledger accounts as formula operands.

For more information, see [Row computations for financial reports](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=HDI_Add_computation_to_rows) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account group maps
tags.description:
An account group map identifies a General Ledger account and, when applicable, its associated account group in the chart of accounts.

**When to use:** Use account group maps to review account assignments and analyze or report on account groupings.

**Relationships:** Each map identifies one General Ledger account and may include an associated account group when the account matches a group range. Accounts without a matching group range are also returned with no associated account group.

**Lifecycle context:** Referenced during financial reporting to identify any account group associated with each General Ledger account.

For more information, see [Map accounts to account groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Mapping_of_accounts_to_account_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account group hierarchies
tags.description:
An account group hierarchy defines the parent-child structure of General Ledger (GL) account groups and accounts within the chart of accounts.

**When to use:** Use to review the structure of account group membership, trace how GL account groups and GL accounts are organized, and understand reporting context for account analysis.

**Relationships:** Linked to GL account groups and GL accounts, with optional location and location group context for reporting dimensions.

**Lifecycle context:** Used as a reference structure in the GL reporting lifecycle to organize account content before reporting or analysis.

For more information, see [organize account groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Organize_account_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Accounting sequences
tags.description:
An accounting sequence assigns a unique sequential number to each posted transaction that affects the General Ledger (GL).

**When to use:** Use to identify the sequence in which posted GL-impacting transactions are processed for reporting, reconciliation, and audit purposes.

**Relationships:** Linked to accounting sequence lines and associated with the entity and journal records that use the numbering sequence.

**Lifecycle context:** Created to establish the valid date range and numbering sequence for posted transactions within a given entity.

For more information, see [Accounting sequences](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_accounting_sequence) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Accounting sequence lines
tags.description:
An accounting sequence line links a General Ledger journal and a document sequence to an accounting sequence used to number posted transactions.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve and review the journal and document-sequence assignments for an accounting sequence.

**Relationships:** Owned by an accounting sequence and linked to a General Ledger journal and a document sequence.

**Lifecycle context:** Defines the numbering sequence applied to posted transactions for the associated journal.

For more information, see [Accounting sequences](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_accounting_sequence) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Budgets
tags.description:
A budget helps track company performance over time by comparing actual results with forecasted figures across predefined reporting periods. It contains budget detail lines with amounts for General Ledger accounts and reporting periods, which may also include dimensions such as locations, departments, or employees.

**When to use:** Use budgets to plan and track company performance over time by comparing actual results with forecasted figures.

**Relationships:** A budget contains budget details. Each detail is associated with a General Ledger account and reporting period and may include dimensions.

**Lifecycle context:** Create budgets with the API and manage their details as lines on the owning budget. When creating a budget, provide an amount for each budget detail; the API does not calculate amounts for calculated budgets. To update an existing detail, include its `key`; to add a detail, omit its `key`. You cannot delete the default budget or a budget used by a financial report.

Before you create a budget, reporting periods must exist and be marked as available for budgeting. Accounts and dimensions referenced in the budget must already be set up in Sage Intacct.

For more information, see [Before you create a budget](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Planning_Your_Intacct_Budgets) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Budget details
tags.description:
A budget detail records a budgeted amount for a General Ledger account and reporting period, optionally with dimensions such as departments and locations.

**When to use:** Use budget details to retrieve or analyze planned amounts by reporting period, account, and dimension.

**Relationships:** A budget detail belongs to an owning budget and is associated with a General Ledger account and reporting period. It can also include dimensions, including user-defined dimensions. Once saved, its account and dimensions cannot be changed.

**Lifecycle context:** Create and maintain budget details through the owning budget. To track budget data by dimension, create a separate budget detail for each account, reporting period, and dimension combination. For example, to budget travel expenses across three locations, create one budget detail for each location.

For more information, see [Overview of creating budgets](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Creating_Editing_Viewing_Budgets) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Journals
tags.description:
A General Ledger journal categorizes transactions entered directly in the General Ledger or posted from subledgers such as Accounts Payable.

**When to use:** Use journals to organize journal entry activity and identify where General Ledger or subledger transactions are posted.

**Relationships:** Journal entries use a journal. Subledger applications can be configured to post transactions to journals.

**Lifecycle context:** Create a journal before it is used for journal entry activity or configured for subledger posting. You can update journal settings through the API. You can delete a journal only if it has no transactions, and deleted journals cannot be recovered.

For more information, see [What journals do you need?](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/General_Ledger/Setup/Journals/add-edit-journals.htm) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_User-defined books
tags.description:
A user-defined book supports reporting needs beyond standard GAAP and tax books. A book configured for management reporting does not affect actual books and can be included alongside them in reports.

**When to use:** Use user-defined books to support specialized accounting or reporting needs.

**Relationships:** User-defined journals can post only to books configured for management reporting. Subledger applications such as Accounts Payable cannot post to management reporting books.

**Lifecycle context:** Enable user-defined books in the General Ledger before creating one. Choose whether a book is for management reporting when you create it; this setting cannot be changed later. You cannot delete a user-defined book while it is in use.

For more information, see [User-defined books](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_user_defined_books_setup) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_User-defined journals
tags.description:
A user-defined journal is used to create journal entries in a user-defined book.

**When to use:** Use user-defined journals to record entries in user-defined books.

**Relationships:** Each user-defined journal is associated with a user-defined book. User-defined journals can post only to books configured for management reporting.

**Lifecycle context:** Create a user-defined journal before creating entries for its book. If direct posting is disabled, entries must be posted through subledger journals. You can delete a user-defined journal only if it has no transactions.

For more information, see [Entries for user-defined books](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_user_defined_books) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Journal entries
tags.description:
A journal entry records accounting transactions in the General Ledger using debit and credit lines. Debits and credits must balance before the entry can be posted.

**When to use:** Use to record and review manual journal activity, including saving entries as drafts before posting to the General Ledger.

**Relationships:** Contains journal entry lines with account, currency, and dimension details. A journal entry is associated with a journal and can include an entity, base location, tax details, an allocation, or a supporting document.

**Lifecycle context:** A journal entry can be posted or saved as a `draft` for review. Draft entries can be updated before posting. Reversal details are available for entries that have been reversed. The journal entry can also have `submitted`, `partiallyApproved`, `approved`, `declined`, `reversalPending`, or `reversed` states.

When General Ledger Outlier Detection is enabled, Sage Intacct identifies journal entries and allocation splits that deviate from expected patterns. Outlier details are included when retrieving a journal entry.

For more information, see [Journal entries](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_journal_entries) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Journal entry lines
tags.description:
A journal entry line represents an individual debit or credit entry within a journal entry.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve or analyze line-level account, amount, currency, dimension, and tax details. Create and update lines through the owning journal entry.

**Relationships:** Owned by a journal entry and associated with a GL account. A line can also include dimensions, currency, an allocation, and tax entries.

**Lifecycle context:** Lines are created or updated through the owning journal entry. The line API supports retrieving or deleting an individual line.

For more information, see [Journal entries](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_journal_entries) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Journal entry tax entries
tags.description:
A journal entry tax entry records tax amounts and tax detail for a journal entry line.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve tax amounts and tax details recorded for VAT/GST-enabled journal entry lines.

**Relationships:** Owned by a journal entry line and associated with a tax detail. Multiple tax entries per line are supported when multiple taxes are enabled in the VAT/GST application configuration.

**Lifecycle context:** Tax entries are recorded with the owning journal entry line. Create, update, or delete them through the parent journal entry request, subject to the VAT/GST configuration and tax solution rules.

For more information, see [Capture tax in a journal entry](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=capture_tax_in_journal_entry) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Journal entry transaction templates
tags.description:
A journal entry transaction template stores reusable details for creating common journal transactions without requiring users to remember the GL journal and debit and credit accounts.

**When to use:** Use to create common journal entries from saved journal and line details.

**Relationships:** Associated with a GL journal and an optional offset GL account, and contains one or more journal entry transaction template lines.

**Lifecycle context:** A journal entry transaction template remains active until it is explicitly deactivated or deleted. Changes to the template do not affect previously created journal entries.

For more information, see [Transaction templates for journal entries](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Creating_Editing_and_Viewing_Transaction_Templates) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Journal entry transaction template lines
tags.description:
A journal entry transaction template line defines a debit or credit entry and its account and dimension settings within a journal entry transaction template.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve or delete an individual line, or to define line details when creating or updating its parent template.

**Relationships:** Owned by a journal entry transaction template and associated with a GL account and dimension values.

**Lifecycle context:** Create lines through POST or PATCH on the parent journal entry transaction template, and update lines through PATCH. Delete a line through this endpoint; the parent template must retain at least one line.

For more information, see [Transaction templates for journal entries](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Creating_Editing_and_Viewing_Transaction_Templates) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Recurring journal entries
tags.description:
Recurring journal entries automate the creation and posting of journal transactions according to a defined schedule, with optional automatic reversals.

**When to use:** Use when you need to create, retrieve, or manage journal transactions that recur on a regular schedule.

**Relationships:** Contains recurring journal entry lines and can reference a journal, attachment, location, entity, and reversal schedule.

**Lifecycle context:** Defines the schedule and posting details for recurring journal transactions, including optional automatic reversals.

For more information, see [recurring journal entries](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_reucrring_journal_entries) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Recurring journal entry lines
tags.description:
A recurring journal entry line represents a single debit or credit entry within a recurring journal entry and captures the amount, account, dimensions, and related details for that line.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve, review, or update the individual lines that make up a recurring journal entry.

**Relationships:** Owned by the recurring journal entry and linked to the GL account, currency, and associated dimensions or allocation template.

**Lifecycle context:** Created as part of the recurring journal entry schedule and retained for tracking and posting activity across recurring cycles.

For more information, see [recurring journal entries](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_reucrring_journal_entries) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Reporting periods
tags.description:
A reporting period defines a date range used to organize financial activity in reports, budgets, and book-close processes.

**When to use:** Use reporting periods to filter financial reports, assign periods to budgets, and manage book opening and closing.

**Relationships:** Budgets and General Ledger reports use reporting periods to associate financial activity with a defined date range.

**Lifecycle context:** Reporting periods are created and managed as part of the financial close process, ensuring that financial activity is accurately captured within the appropriate time frames.

For more information, see [Learn about reporting periods](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Reporting_periods_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Adjustment journals
tags.description:
A general ledger adjustment journal represents journal entries used to make adjustments to closed accounting periods. Each adjustment journal contains its own line items, and you can create as many adjustment journals as needed.

**When to use:** Use when creating, retrieving, or managing journal entries that adjust closed accounting periods.

**Relationships:** Contains its own line items and can be configured to allow or disallow direct posting.

**Lifecycle context:** Used to record adjustments after an accounting period has closed.

For more information, see [Adjustment journals](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Viewing_and_Managing_Adjustment_Journals) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_GAAP adjustment journals
tags.description:
A GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) adjustment journal represents journal entries used to post adjustments without changing historical monthly amounts, maintaining the integrity of operational reporting.

**When to use:** Use when creating, retrieving, or managing adjustments that do not change historical monthly amounts.

**Relationships:** Contains its own line items and can be configured for billable entries and direct-posting behavior.

**Lifecycle context:** Used to record GAAP adjustments while preserving historical operational reporting.

For more information, see [GAAP adjustments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_gaap_and_tax_adjustments) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Tax adjustment journals
tags.description:
A tax adjustment journal records tax changes for transactions already posted to the general ledger. It helps correct errors, reflect tax law updates, and keep tax liability records accurate and compliant.

**When to use:** Use when creating, retrieving, or managing tax adjustments for transactions that are already posted to the general ledger.

**Relationships:** Contains its own line items and is associated with the general ledger transactions being adjusted.

**Lifecycle context:** Used to correct or update tax information after the related transaction has been posted.

For more information, see [tax adjustments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_gaap_and_tax_adjustments) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Statistical accounts
tags.description:
A statistical account tracks non-financial quantities in the General Ledger, such as employee headcount, membership, or room counts.

**When to use:** Use statistical accounts to record and report non-financial quantities alongside financial account activity.

**Relationships:** Statistical accounts can be included in statistical account groups and assigned to categories for reporting. In consolidated company structures, they can be consolidated similarly to General Ledger accounts.

**Lifecycle context:** The account can be active or inactive. Accounts used in a book transaction cannot be deleted.

For more information, see [Statistical accounts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_Statistical_Account_Info) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Statistical journals
tags.description:
A statistical journal records non-monetary journal entries that increase or decrease values without debits or credits.

**When to use:** Use this endpoint to list, create, retrieve, update, or delete statistical journals referenced by statistical journal entries.

**Relationships:** A statistical journal is referenced by each statistical journal entry recorded in it.

**Lifecycle context:** Create a statistical journal before recording entries in it. You can delete it only when it contains no transactions.

For more information, see [Statistical journals](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_stat_journals) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Statistical journal entries
tags.description:
A statistical journal entry records non-financial transactions in a statistical journal for reporting and analysis.

**When to use:** Use statistical journal entries to record, update, or reverse statistical transactions, or to report on non-financial measures alongside financial activity.

**Relationships:** Each entry belongs to a statistical journal and contains at least one statistical transaction line. A reversed entry links to the statistical journal entry that reversed it.

**Lifecycle context:** Create an entry as a draft for review or post it immediately. Draft entries can be updated before posting, and entries can be reversed.

For more information, see [Statistical journals and journal entries](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_statistical_journals_and_journal_entries) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Statistical journal entry lines
tags.description:
A statistical journal entry line records an individual non-monetary transaction within a statistical journal entry.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve or analyze the entries that make up a statistical journal entry.

**Relationships:** Owned by a statistical journal entry. Create or update lines by modifying their parent statistical journal entry.

**Lifecycle context:** A line’s lifecycle is managed through its parent statistical journal entry. Create or update lines by modifying the parent entry; lines are posted or saved as drafts as part of that entry.

For more information, see [Create a statistical journal entry](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Create_stat_JE_1) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Statistical adjustment journals
tags.description:
A statistical adjustment journal stores entries made to closed periods, allowing necessary adjustments without reopening the period.

**When to use:** Use to set up one or more statistical adjustment journals before creating statistical adjusting entries.

**Relationships:** Statistical adjusting entries are posted against this journal to record non-financial adjustments to a closed period.

**Lifecycle context:** Statistical adjustment journals let you record non-financial adjustments to a period after it has been closed, without reopening the period itself.

For more information, see [Add a statistical adjustment journal](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Stat_Adj_Jrnl_Info) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Transaction allocation templates
tags.description:
A transaction allocation template stores reusable allocation lines for distributing a transaction line amount across dimensions. Set `allocateBy` to `percentage` to allocate by percentages, `exactAmount` to allocate specified amounts, or `fixedAmount` to combine exact amounts and percentages. For `fixedAmount`, exact amounts are allocated first, and percentages distribute the remainder.

**When to use:** Apply a template during transaction entry to distribute an amount for one transaction line. You can reuse the template on other lines.

**Relationships:** A template contains lines. Each line specifies an amount or percentage and the dimensions for that allocation, such as department, location, project, or class.

**Lifecycle context:** Transaction allocations are applied to transaction lines during entry and can use standard allocation dimensions. Allocations based on current source balances and allocation bases are handled separately as dynamic allocations.

For more information, see [About transaction allocations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Allocations_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Transaction allocation template lines
tags.description:
A transaction allocation template line defines an amount or percentage allocated by a transaction allocation template.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve allocation details or review how a transaction allocation template distributes values across dimensions.

**Relationships:** Owned by a transaction allocation template and associated with the dimensions used for allocation.

**Lifecycle context:** Added, updated, and deleted through the owning transaction allocation template.

For more information, see [About transaction allocations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Allocations_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Financial graphs
tags.description:
A financial graph is a saved visualization of General Ledger data for reviewing financial performance and trends.

**When to use:** Retrieve saved graphs to review financial results or monitor trends.

**Relationships:** A graph's configured data series determine the General Ledger data it displays.

**Lifecycle context:** Financial graphs can be retrieved or deleted. Their details can include a chart type, primary and secondary data series, and an as-of date.

For more information, see [Financial graphs](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_financial_graphs) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Reporting accounts
tags.description:
A reporting account provides an optional reporting structure in the General Ledger. It represents a financial or statistical reporting account and can be linked to one or more General Ledger or statistical accounts.

**When to use:** Use reporting accounts to organize General Ledger accounts into custom groupings for financial reporting, or to organize statistical accounts for reporting quantities or units.

**Relationships:** Each reporting account belongs to one reporting account set and can have reporting account maps that link it to General Ledger accounts for financial reporting or statistical accounts for statistical reporting.

**Lifecycle context:** Created and maintained as part of reporting account set configuration, then used with its account mappings when generating financial or statistical reports.

For more information, see [Reporting accounts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Reporting_accounts) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Reporting account maps
tags.description:
A reporting account map associates one reporting account with either one General Ledger account for financial reporting or one statistical account for statistical reporting.

**When to use:** Use reporting account maps to define which General Ledger or statistical accounts contribute to a reporting account in custom financial or statistical reports.

**Relationships:** Each reporting account map belongs to one reporting account and links to either one General Ledger account or one statistical account, but not both.

**Lifecycle context:** Created and maintained as part of reporting account setup, then used when generating financial or statistical reports.

For more information, see [Mapping GL accounts to reporting accounts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Options_for_mapping_reporting_accounts) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Reporting account sets
tags.description:
A reporting account set groups reporting accounts for General Ledger financial and statistical reporting.

**When to use:** Use reporting account sets to organize reporting accounts for financial statements, statistical reporting, or consolidated reporting across entities.

**Relationships:** Each reporting account set has an administrator, contains reporting accounts, and includes permissions that control access for users or user groups.

**Lifecycle context:** Created and maintained during reporting setup. The administrator manages the reporting accounts, account mappings, and permissions associated with the set, which is then used for financial or statistical reporting.

For more information, see [Reporting account sets](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Reporting_account_sets) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Reporting account set permissions
tags.description:
A reporting account set permission defines whether access to a reporting account set is allowed or denied for everyone, a specific user group, or an individual user.

**When to use:** Use reporting account set permissions to control access to reporting account sets for all users, a user group, or an individual user.

**Relationships:** Each permission belongs to one reporting account set and applies either to everyone, a specific user group, or an individual user. The permission specifies whether access is allowed or denied.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured as part of reporting account set security and evaluated when users access the associated reporting account set.

For more information, see [Reporting account sets](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Reporting_account_sets) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Report audiences
tags.description:
A report audience identifies the intended users or stakeholders for a General Ledger report, such as directors, board members, or internal users.

**When to use:** Use report audiences to describe the intended readership of reports and organize reports by audience.

**Relationships:** Associated with an entity when reporting is scoped by entity.

**Lifecycle Context:** Created and maintained during report setup, then referenced to document the intended audience for a General Ledger report.

For more information, see [General Ledger reports](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=GL_reports_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Report types
tags.description:
A report type identifies the business category of a General Ledger report. Common examples include balance sheets, income statements, cash flow reports, and trial balances.

**When to use:** Use report types to classify General Ledger reports and organize reporting definitions.

**Relationships:** Referenced by reporting objects to identify the report category and may be associated with an entity when reporting is scoped by entity.

**Lifecycle context:** Created and maintained during reporting setup, then referenced when configuring and running General Ledger reports.

For more information, see [General Ledger reports](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=GL_reports_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Reporting categories
tags.description:
A reporting category organizes General Ledger accounts for financial statement reporting or tracks non-financial operational metrics.

**When to use:** Use reporting categories to group accounts by financial statement classification, such as assets, liabilities, equity, income, cost of revenue, and expenses, or to track operational metrics with statistical categories.

**Relationships:** Linked to General Ledger accounts and account groups, and assigned to accounts for presentation in financial statements and operational reporting.

**Lifecycle context:** Used during account setup and ongoing reporting, where the category provides the classification needed for financial statement generation and operational analysis.

For more information, see [QuickStart overview](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Quickstart_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account balance reports
tags.description:
The account balance report provides a snapshot of account balances for a specified period, showing opening balances, period activity, and closing balances across accounts and dimensions. This endpoint allows you to submit a request to generate the account balance report for processing. The response includes a `reportId` and `href` that can be used to check the processing status of the report.

**When to use:** Run the account balance report for asynchronous processing and retrieve the report status.

**Relationships:** Related to reporting periods, reporting books, GL accounts, and dimensions such as locations, departments, and projects.

**Lifecycle context:** Generated based on the specified parameters, and the response provides information to track the processing status of the report.

For more information, see [Account balances report](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Running_Account_Balances_Reports) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account balance by dimension reports
tags.description:
The account balance by dimension report provides a detailed view of account balances across specified dimensions, such as location, department, and project, for a given period. This endpoint allows you to submit a request to generate the account balance by dimension report for processing. The response includes a `reportId` and `href` that can be used to check the processing status of the report.

**When to use:** Run the account balance by dimension report for asynchronous processing and retrieve the report status.

**Relationships:** Related to reporting periods, reporting books, GL accounts, and dimensions such as locations, departments, and projects.

**Lifecycle context:** Generated based on the specified parameters, and the response provides information to track the processing status of the report.

For more information, see [Dimension balances reports](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_dim_bal_rpt) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_Account group hierarchy reports
tags.description:
The account group hierarchy report provides a structured view of your account groups, their member account groups, and the accounts within those groups. This report is useful for understanding the organization of your accounts and how they roll up into financial statements. The report can be customized with various parameters to filter and format the output according to your needs.

**When to use:** Run the account group hierarchy report for asynchronous processing and retrieve the report status.

**Relationships:** Related to account groups, account categories, reporting account sets, and General Ledger accounts to define the hierarchy.

**Lifecycle context:** Generated based on the specified parameters, and the response provides information to track the processing status of the report.

For more information, see [Account group hierarchy reports](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_acct_grp_hier_rpt) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: General_Ledger_GL details reports
tags.description:
The GL details report provides a comprehensive view of all transactions and activities recorded in the general ledger accounts for a specified period. This endpoint allows you to submit a request to generate the GL details report for processing. The response includes a `reportId` and `href` that can be used to check the processing status of the report.

**When to use:** Run the GL details report for asynchronous processing and retrieve the report status.

**Relationships:** Related to reporting periods, reporting books, GL accounts, and dimensions such as locations and departments.

**Lifecycle context:** Generated based on the specified parameters, and the response provides information to track the processing status of the report.

For more information, see [General Ledger reports](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_gl_report) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

objects.general-ledger.account.description: A General Ledger account records and organizes financial transactions.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the account.

id.description: Unique ID for the account. The permitted length is configured at the company level.

name.description: Name or title of the account, which appears on report headings. Maximum length is 80 characters.

accountType.description:
Type of account:
* `balanceSheet` - A snapshot of the current state of a company's assets, liabilities, and equity at a specific time.
* `incomeStatement` - Income statement accounts, sometimes called Profit and Loss statements, are cumulative for the selected period.

normalBalance.description: Normal balance of the account from an accounting perspective. For example, expense accounts normally have a debit balance, and sales accounts normally have a credit balance.

closingType.description:
Specifies how the account is handled during year-end closing:

* `nonClosingAccount` - Balance sheet accounts that do not close at year-end.
* `closingAccount` - Income statement account that closes to retained earnings at year-end. Specify a `closeToGLAccount`, typically the Retained Earnings account.
* `closedToAccount` - Account designated to receive balances from other accounts during year-end closing, such as the Retained Earnings account.

closeToGLAccount.description: GL account associated with the account for transferring balances during year-end closing. Required when `closingType` is `closingAccount`.

key.description: Unique key for the GL account.

href.description: URL endpoint for the GL account.

alternativeGLAccount.description:
Specifies whether this GL account overrides the default GL account for AP or AR transactions:

* `payablesAccount` - Overrides the default AP GL account for bills, adjustments, and transactions involving a vendor.
* `receivablesAccount` - Overrides the default AR GL account for invoices, adjustments, and transactions involving a customer.
* `none` - Does not override a default AP or AR GL account.

Use this account as the override for all transaction lines or assign it to individual lines. For vendor or customer transactions, use it as the balancing account. This field applies only to bills, invoices, and adjustments; it does not apply to recurring bills or invoices, manual payments, manual deposits, or advances.

disallowDirectPosting.description: Indicates whether direct posting to the account is disallowed. If `true`, entries must be posted through subledger journals so the account retains supporting subledger details.

enableGLMatching.description: Indicates whether GL matching is enabled for the account.

reconciliationSequence.description: Reconciliation sequence identifier used for GL matching.

isGermanTaxAccount.description: Indicates whether tax is included in the DATEV export for the account.

category.description: Category used to organize accounts in predefined reports, graphs, and performance cards. Available only for companies using a QuickStart template; the available values depend on the template selected for the company. The selected category determines `accountType`, `normalBalance`, and `closingType`.

isTaxable.description: Indicates whether the account is taxable.

taxCode.description: Provide the tax return code needed by external tax compliance products to map tax codes to the tax forms that the company uses. Requires tax codes to be enabled in the General Ledger.

mrcCode.description: The M-3 return code box to map M-3 return codes to your M-3 form.

constructionCategory.description:
Category of general ledger account:

- `cost` - The account is used to track job costs.
- `revenue` -  The account is used to track job billings.
- `overbilling` -  The account is used to post overbilling amounts.
- `underbilling` -  The account is used to post underbilling amounts.
- `offset` - The account is used to post adjustments for both overbilling and underbilling amounts.
- `underbillingOffset` - The account is used to post adjustments for underbilling amounts.
- `overbillingOffset` - The account is used to post adjustments for overbilling amounts.

* `notConsidered` - Excluded from calculations, but can still be used to filter the source pool or basis. Leave this blank, or set a single override value in `glAccountAllocationTarget`.
* `preserveValues` - Keeps original dimension values and includes them in source and basis calculations to preserve proportional distribution in allocated entries.
* `allocationFocus` - Allocates or reclassifies by this dimension based on the method in `glAccountAllocationBasis`, and includes it in dynamic basis calculations.

activityDelta.description:
Indicates whether the account allocation applies enhanced validation so each generation clears prior source amounts. This is useful for allocations that run multiple times in a period, such as payroll.

When true, Sage Intacct validates that accounts in the source pool are also used in the reversing source pool. If a different reversal account is used, it must be included in the source pool account group to offset prior allocations.

Allocated entries must be properly recorded in the source books to ensure prior allocations are fully considered.

This option is effective only when the source account is used for pool reversal in the allocation target through `glAccountAllocationTarget` or `glAccountAllocationReverse`.

autoReversePriorPostedJournalEntry.description:
Indicates whether the account allocation automatically reverses previously posted journal entries.

When true, Sage Intacct checks for an existing allocation in the same source period and reverses it before generating a new allocation. The reversal uses the new allocation’s posting date and resets amounts so prior allocations are not double-counted.

This improves accuracy by using the latest basis values for the full period. You cannot set this to true after allocations have already been generated for the definition.

* `endOfPeriod` - Cumulative amounts through the end of the selected period.

All accounts in the account group should have the same normal balance. The group uses the designation at its top level. For example, if the parent group has a debit normal balance, all included accounts are added, regardless of their individual normal balance settings.

* `groups` - Contains other account groups.

* `computation` - Uses other account groups or individual accounts as components in a mathematical equation; the result appears in financial reports.
* `category` - Contains accounts based on categories configured when the company was set up.
* `statisticalCategory` - Contains statistical accounts based on preconfigured categories.
* `null` - Not supported.

reportingBook.description: Reporting book used for the account balance report, which determines the accounting method applied to the report. Use `ACCRUAL` for accrual basis accounting or `CASH` for cash basis accounting, depending on the company configuration. If Global Consolidations is enabled, you can provide a consolidation book ID instead.

ownershipStructure.description: Ownership structure associated with the account balance report that determines the entities to include based on the consolidation configuration.

adjustmentBooks.description:
Adjustment books to include in the account balance report, which allows you to combine entries from specified adjustment books with the reporting book.

If specified, the report can include separate columns for each adjustment book. When `includeReportingBook` is `true`, those columns appear alongside the main reporting book; otherwise, the output includes only the specified adjustment books. If using Global Consolidations, you can provide consolidation adjustment books instead.

includeReportingBook.description: Indicates whether to include the reporting book in the report. Set to `true` to include the reporting book alongside any specified adjustment books. Set to `false` to include only the specified adjustment books. If using Global Consolidations, this includes the consolidation reporting book.

glAccountGroup.description: Predefined General Ledger (GL) account group, which is a saved set of multiple accounts to include in the report. Use this as an alternative to entering account ranges and when GL account numbers are not used.

key.description: Unique key for the account group.

href.description: URL endpoint for the account group.

individualReport.description: Options for generating individual reports based on dimensions. If any of these options are enabled, the system generates separate reports for each unique value within the specified dimensions.

includeLocation.description: Indicates whether to create a separate report for individual locations or location groups. Set to `true` to create a separate report for each location. For location groups, this creates a separate report for the individual locations within the group.

excludeLocationBlankPages.description: Indicates whether to exclude blank pages from individual location reports. Set to `true` to suppress output pages for locations that have no data for the selected period. Applies only when `includeLocation` is `true`.

includeDepartment.description: Indicates whether to create a separate report for individual departments or department groups. Set to `true` to create a separate report for each department. For department groups, this creates a separate report for the individual departments within the group.

excludeDepartmentBlankPages.description: Indicates whether to exclude blank pages from individual department reports. Set to `true` to suppress output pages for departments that have no data for the selected period. Applies only when `includeDepartment` is `true`.

showYTDBalances.description: Indicates whether to display year-to-date (YTD) balances in the report.

showReportingCategory.description: Indicates whether to include the reporting category in the report.

accountSelection.description:

* `multiple` - Uses `glAccountGroup` to specify a predefined set of accounts by referencing a saved group of accounts configured in Sage Intacct.

includeDepartment.description: Indicates whether to create a separate report for individual departments or department groups. Set to `true` to create a separate report for each department. For department groups, this creates a separate report for the individual departments within the group.

excludeDepartmentBlankPages.description: Indicates whether to exclude blank pages from individual department reports. Set to `true` to suppress output pages for departments that have no data for the selected period. Applies only when `includeDepartment` is `true`.

services.reports.general-ledger-details.description: The General Ledger (GL) details report provides a comprehensive view of all transactions and activities recorded in the general ledger accounts for a specified period.

reportName.description:
A user-defined name assigned to the report execution.
This value is stored with the generated report and is used as a label to help identify and track
the report after submission.
This field does not reference or select a predefined report configuration and is not validated
against existing report definitions.

outputType.description: Indicates the output format of the GL details report.

outputLocation.description: Indicates where to store the generated GL details report.

parameters.description: Defines the input parameters for the GL details report, including time period, reporting book, dimensions, account filters, and output options.

reportingAccountLabel.description: Specifies options for including a reporting account label in the GL details report.

includeReportingAccountLabel.description: Indicates whether to include a reporting account label in the GL details report.

href.description: URL endpoint for the reporting account set.

reportingBook.description: Specifies the reporting book used for the GL details report, which determines the accounting method applied to the report. Use `ACCRUAL` for accrual basis accounting or `CASH` for cash basis accounting, depending on the company configuration. If Global Consolidations is enabled, you can provide a consolidation book ID instead.

ownershipStructure.description: References the ownership structure associated with the GL details report, which determines the entities to include based on the consolidation configuration.

key.description: Unique key for the ownership structure.

href.description: URL endpoint for the ownership structure.

adjustmentBooks.description:
Specifies the adjustment books to include in the GL details report, which allows you to combine entries from specified adjustment books with the reporting book.

If specified, the report can include separate columns for each adjustment book. When `includeReportingBook` is `true`, those columns appear alongside the main reporting book; otherwise, the output includes only the specified adjustment books. If using Global Consolidations, you can provide consolidation adjustment books instead.

includeReportingBook.description: Indicates whether to include the reporting book in the report. Set to `true` to include the reporting book alongside any specified adjustment books. Set to `false` to include only the specified adjustment books. If using Global Consolidations, this includes the consolidation reporting book.

txnStateSelection.description: Indicates which transactions to include based on their posting status, either posted transactions, unposted transactions, or both. When selecting unposted transactions or both posted and unposted transactions, you can further filter which unposted transactions to include using the `txnStateFilter` parameter.

txnStateFilter.description: Indicates which unposted transactions to include in the report based on their transaction state, either draft, partially approved, submitted, or declined. Applies when `txnStateSelection` is set to include unposted transactions.

glAccountRange.description: Collection of GL account ranges used to select accounts for the report.

glReportingAccountRange.description: Collection of reporting account ranges used to select accounts for the report.

accountSelection.description:
Specifies how to select accounts for the report:

* `range`: Select accounts within the specified `glAccountRange` or `glReportingAccountRange`. GL account range takes precedence if both are specified.
* `multiple`: Select specific GL account or reporting account numbers. GL account numbers take precedence if both are specified.
* `all`: Include all accounts; all filters are ignored.

includeStatisticalAccounts.description: Indicates whether to include statistical accounts in the report. Statistical accounts are used to track non-financial data, such as employee headcount, or number of members.

glAccountGroup.description: References the account group associated with the report. Required if not using the GL account numbers.

key.description: Unique key for the account group.

href.description: URL endpoint for the account group.

dimensionReportStructure.description:
References the dimension report structure associated with the report, which determines the dimensions and dimension values to include in the report.

For more information, read about [dimension structures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_dimension_structures) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

key.description: Unique key for the dimension report structure.

id.description: Identifier for the dimension report structure.

href.description: URL endpoint for the dimension report structure.

txnFilter.description: Specifies which locations to include when filtering report transactions in multi-entity shared companies: all locations, only the selected location, or the selected location and its child locations.

individualReport.description: Provides options for generating individual reports based on dimensions. If any of these options are enabled, the system generates separate reports for each unique value within the specified dimensions.

includeLocation.description: Indicates whether to create a separate report for individual locations or location groups. Set to `true` to create a separate report for each location. For location groups, this creates a separate report for the individual locations within the group.

excludeLocationBlankPages.description: Indicates whether to exclude blank pages from individual location reports. Set to `true` to suppress output pages for locations that have no data for the selected period. Applies only when `includeLocation` is `true`.

includeDepartment.description: Indicates whether to create a separate report for individual departments or department groups. Set to `true` to create a separate report for each department. For department groups, this creates a separate report for the individual departments within the group.

excludeDepartmentBlankPages.description: Indicates whether to exclude blank pages from individual department reports. Set to `true` to suppress output pages for departments that have no data for the selected period. Applies only when `includeDepartment` is `true`.

reportOrientation.description: Indicates the orientation of the GL details report, which can be either portrait or landscape.

showZeroBalanceAccounts.description:
Indicates how zero-balance accounts are displayed in the report:

* `all` - Shows all zero-balance accounts, regardless of activity.
* `onlyWithActivity` - Displays only zero-balance accounts that had activity during the reporting period.
* `doNotShow` - Excludes all zero-balance accounts from the report.

showDetail.description: Indicates whether to include detailed transaction lines in the GL details report.

documentNumberType.description: Indicates which document number to display in the GL details report, either the reference number or the bill, invoice, or adjustment number.

showDimensionActivity.description: Indicates whether to show department and location activity columns in the GL details report.

showNetChange.description: Indicates whether to show a net change column in the GL details report, which calculates the net change for each account by subtracting total credits from total debits during the reporting period.

showTxnNumber.description: Indicates whether to show transaction numbers in the GL details report.

showYTDBalances.description: Indicates whether to show year-to-date (YTD) balance columns in the GL details report.

showAccountOnLines.description: Indicates whether to repeat the account number and name on each transaction line in the GL details report.

showFilters.description: Indicates whether to show filter selection in the GL details report.

showTxnSubtotals.description: Indicates whether to show transaction subtotals in the GL details report. Subtotals are based on the grouping selected for the report, such as by location, department, or dimension values.

showOffsetDetails.description: Indicates whether to show offset account totals in the GL details report.

showPeriodTotals.description: Indicates whether to show period subtotals in the GL details report, which provide totals for each reporting period included in the report.

groupBy.description: Indicates how to group the GL details report by location, department, or by both with location grouped within department or department grouped within location.

fitToOnePage.description: Indicates whether to resize columns to fit them to a single page in the GL details report.

adjustmentBooks.description:

When `includeReportingBook` is `true`, those columns appear alongside the main reporting book; otherwise, the output includes only the specified adjustment books. includeReportingBook.description: Indicates whether to include the reporting book in the trial balance report when adjustment books are specified. If `true`, the report includes columns for the reporting book alongside any specified adjustment books; if `false`, the report includes only the specified adjustment books.

individualReport.description: Provides options for generating individual reports based on dimensions. If any of these options are enabled, the system generates separate reports for each unique value within the specified dimensions.

includeLocation.description: Indicates whether to create a separate report for individual locations or location groups. Set to `true` to create a separate report for each location. For location groups, this creates a separate report for the individual locations within the group.

excludeLocationBlankPages.description: Indicates whether to exclude blank pages from individual location reports. Set to `true` to suppress output pages for locations that have no data for the selected period. Applies only when `includeLocation` is `true`.

includeDepartment.description: Indicates whether to create a separate report for individual departments or department groups. Set to `true` to create a separate report for each department. For department groups, this creates a separate report for the individual departments within the group.

excludeDepartmentBlankPages.description: Indicates whether to exclude blank pages from individual department reports. Set to `true` to suppress output pages for departments that have no data for the selected period. Applies only when `includeDepartment` is `true`.

excludeAdjustments.description: Indicates whether to exclude adjustment journal entry debits and credits from the report. When `true`, only standard (non-adjustment) entries contribute to the reported balances.

showYTDBalances.description: Indicates whether to display year-to-date (YTD) balances in the output for the trial balance report.

showZeroBalanceAccounts.description:
Indicates how zero-balance accounts are displayed in the report:

* `all` - Shows all zero-balance accounts, regardless of activity.
* `onlyWithActivity` - Displays only zero-balance accounts that had activity during the reporting period.
* `doNotShow` - Excludes all zero-balance accounts from the report.

showStatisticalAccounts.description:
Indicates how statistical accounts are displayed in the report:

* `showStatisticalAccounts` - Shows all statistical accounts in the report.
* `onlyShowStatisticalAccounts` - Displays only statistical accounts in the report, excluding all non-statistical accounts.
* `doNotShowStatisticalAccounts` - Excludes all statistical accounts from the report.

showDebitCreditBalances.description: Indicates whether to show debit and credit balances in separate columns in the report, instead of showing a single net balance column.

reportOrientation.description: Indicates the orientation of the trial balance report, which can be either portrait or landscape.
